It also says no paid upgrades, and total gross booking price must not exceed $180. Also cancellations are permitted, but cancellations do not reset the gross booking budget.

No paid upgrades are permitted. The new date is authorized from this instruction onward. The total gross booking budget is now 370.00 USD, counting the cancelled first purchase too.
